blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
A company's main tax is corporate tax. The company pays it on its profit each year.

The calculation is simple. You start with the profit from the income statement. You take away the allowed deductions. Then you multiply by the corporate tax rate. Different countries have different rates, and different types of company pay different rates too. Small companies sometimes pay a reduced rate. A start-up in some sectors may pay almost nothing for a few years, because the government wants to encourage new activity.

For the company, corporate tax is an annual event. It needs preparing all through the year. It is not a surprise that arrives in the post when the books are closed.

items.q: What tax does a company pay on its profit each year?
items.why: "A company's main tax is corporate tax. The company pays it on its profit each year."

items.q: Where does the calculation start?
options: With the profit from the income statement
items.why: "You start with the profit from the income statement."

items.q: Why might a start-up pay almost nothing for a few years?
options: Because the government wants to encourage new activity
Because it never makes a profit
Because it is a small company
items.why: "the government wants to encourage new activity."

items.q: The text suggests that corporate tax should be…
options: left until the books are closed
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz "It needs preparing all through the year" e critica deixar para depois.

items.q: The writer would most likely DISAGREE with which idea?
options: All companies pay the same rate.
Small companies can pay a reduced rate.
Corporate tax is paid on profit.
Tax should not be a surprise.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que países e tipos de empresa pagam alíquotas diferentes, então não é uma alíquota única.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie explicando à nova colaboradora. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Okay, welcome to the team. This is your very first corporate tax filing, so let's go through it slowly, step by step. Don't worry — it is not difficult at all when you follow the steps in order.

First, open the income statement and find the profit for the year. That number is where we start. Write it at the top of the page.

Next, we take away the deductions. These are the costs the law allows us to remove before we calculate the tax. When you finish, you have the taxable profit.

Now the important part. We multiply the taxable profit by the tax rate. Our company is small this year, so we use the reduced rate. Check that number twice, please. A small mistake here changes the final figure a lot.

One more thing. We do a little of this work every month. We never wait until the end of the year. If you keep the file clean all year, the filing is calm and there are no surprises. That is the whole idea.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What does Sophie tell the junior to find FIRST?
options: The profit for the year on the income statement
items.why: "open the income statement and find the profit for the year. That number is where we start."

items.q: What are the deductions?
options: The costs the law allows us to remove before calculating the tax
items.why: "These are the costs the law allows us to remove before we calculate the tax."

items.q: Which rate does the company use this year?
options: The reduced rate, because the company is small
items.why: "Our company is small this year, so we use the reduced rate."

items.q: Why does Sophie ask the junior to check the number twice?
options: Because a small mistake there changes the final figure a lot
items.why: Inferência: ela diz "A small mistake here changes the final figure a lot" — por isso a atenção extra.

items.q: What is Sophie's main advice about the work?
options: Do a little every month, so there are no surprises
Wait until the end of the year
Let someone else do the calculation
Only work on it in December
items.why: Inferência: "We do a little of this work every month… the filing is calm and there are no surprises."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The company pays corporate tax on its profit." Corporate tax is…
options: the tax a company pays on its profit
a tax on each employee's salary
a tax on sales to customers
a fee for opening a bank account
items.why: Corporate tax = imposto corporativo, pago sobre o lucro da empresa.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We find the profit for the year on the ___."
items.why: Income statement = demonstração de resultado, onde aparece o lucro.

items.q: "A small company can pay a reduced rate." A reduced rate is…
options: a lower tax rate than normal
items.why: Reduced rate = alíquota reduzida, mais baixa que a normal.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The government wants to ___ new business, so start-ups pay very little."
items.why: To encourage = incentivar; o governo quer estimular novos negócios.

items.q: "Corporate tax is an annual event." Annual means…
items.why: Annual = anual, que acontece uma vez por ano.

blocks.instruction: Expressões que aparecem em reuniões sobre impostos e finanças. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager still has to sign off on the tax file." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "Let's go through the numbers together." To go through means to…
items.why: Go through = revisar passo a passo.

items.q: "We can take away the allowed costs before the tax." To take away means to…
items.why: Take away = tirar, subtrair — as deduções antes do cálculo.

items.q: "Please fill in the tax form with the final figure." To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher com as informações.

items.q: "We do a little each month so tax time never catches us out." To catch someone out means to…
options: surprise them when they are not ready
items.why: Catch out = pegar de surpresa, desprevenido.
